A company is creating an advertisement for its custom-made guitars. Which of the following statements should be in the advertisement to best emphasize the company's custom production processes?
choices: Our guitars are made using hand tools.
We make our guitars to your specifications.
We produce and sell thousands of guitars each year.
Our guitars are the best quality your money can buy.

stem: In the carbon cycle, carbon moves from reservoir to reservoir as various organic and inorganic processes occur on Earth. Only a small percentage of the global carbon is moved in this cycle each year. The remaining carbon is stored in these reservoirs. Which reservoir contains the greatest amount of stored carbon?
The heart is the major organ of the circulatory system. Which part of the body is responsible for delivering de-oxygenated blood to the heart?
Which characteristic does a paramecium have in common with volvox?
choices: lives as one of a colony of cells

stem: A geologist conducts an investigation to determine the absolute age of a fossil. She then repeats the procedure three times. Which best explains why she repeated the procedure several times?
choices: It helps her develop better procedures.
It improves the accuracy of the results.
She wants all the results to be different.
She has more than one hypothesis to prove.

stem: Which characteristic property indicates that igneous rock cools slowly?

When Chemical X is added to a certain liquid, the chemical breaks into Substances Y and Z. It is not possible to break Substances Y and Z into simpler particles. Which statement is best supported by this evidence?
choices: Chemical X is soluble in water.
Substances Y and Z are elements.
Substances Y and Z are compounds.

stem: Which of the following is least likely to change from a solid state to a liquid state when heat is applied?

A hydrologist is studying the acidity level of a city lake. She collects samples twice a week and takes them to her lab to test them. After testing the samples, she places the data on a graph. She tells the city engineers that her tests indicate that the pH level has been steadily dropping over the past few months. Which of the following steps is the best way to check the accuracy of her data?
choices: show the graphs to the engineers
show the samples to the engineers

stem: A doorbell contains a simple electromagnet. Which change would most likely increase the strength of an electromagnet?

Uranus is one of the outer planets of the solar system. The average distance of Uranus from the Sun is 2.87 billion kilometers. Which best explains why Uranus revolves in its orbit instead of moving out into space?
choices: The orbit of Neptune limits Uranus.
Gravity pulls Uranus toward the Sun.
Other planets have the same mass as Uranus.

stem: The burning of fossil fuels has increased the carbon dioxide content of the atmosphere. What is a possible effect that the increased amount of carbon dioxide is likely to have on our planet?

Several horses grazed in a fenced area across from a home. On rainy days, soil would wash down a slope and run toward the home. After the horses were moved a few years later, the soil no longer washed down when it rained. What could account for this change?
choices: The grass grew and kept the soil intact.
The fence kept the soil contained.

stem: Students want to plant a lemon tree at their school, but the cold winter temperatures in Massachusetts would kill the tree. Which of the following is the best solution to this problem?
choices: planting several lemon trees together in a row
building a greenhouse to shelter the lemon tree
giving the lemon tree extra fertilizer in the winter
tying a stake to the lemon tree for support during the winter

stem: A species lives in a region that changes over time from temperate to tropical. The survival of the species will be most probable if the species can do which of the following?
choices: emigrate before the change is complete

stem: Human interaction with the environment has led to increasing amounts of acid rain. Which population have humans adversely affected the most by contributing to the production of acid rain?
A car is traveling on a highway at a constant velocity. Which statement best describes the forces acting on the car?
choices: The forces acting on the car are balanced.
The forces acting on the car are in the same direction.
The forces acting on the car are continuing to increase.
The forces acting on the car are equal to the force of gravity.

stem: Which change will occur in the wire of an electrical circuit that is working properly?
choices: The wire will lose some of its mass.
The wire will form an electric field.
The wire will develop a new crystal structure.

stem: What is a difference between mitosis and meiosis?
choices: Mitosis occurs in all the cells in animals and plants, while meiosis occurs in only in bacteria.
In mitosis, the products are identical to the parent cell, while in meiosis the products are different from the parent cell.
In mitosis, one cell divides into two cells, while in meiosis two cells combine to make one cell.
Mitosis involves separating the chromosomes, while meiosis involves only the cytoplasm of the cell.

choices: the distance the roller coaster car must travel
the mass of the roller coaster car at full capacity
